## History

Skinner was courted by [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Skinner for a considerable time before marrying him. Serving as a temporary mail driver, she gave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a ride to Janet's home from the [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station. During the drive, she entertained [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with stories regarding her romantic decisions and recent marriage.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P5](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0005), [v3 ch.Romance P7](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0007), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_
